description: A left-to-right system diagram with four columns. There are NO column headers and NO captions of any kind: the only text in the image is the labels quoted here. Column 1: a rounded browser-window shape labelled 'Workflow Studio' containing three small labelled regions 'Palette', 'Canvas', 'Run panel'. Column 2: a document card 'Workflow JSON' with arrows to and from column 1 labelled 'save' and 'run'. Column 3: a box 'Studio engine' with a small cylinder beneath it 'Runs and waits'. Column 4: a box 'Toolbox · the same 15 tools as Ask Rasoi' above a box 'Your own Rasoi · Bahi ERP 7.2' (ember tint). Along the bottom, a thin green line spanning columns 3-4 labelled 'every write: preview, confirm, idempotency key, the person's own permissions'. Sky blue for the new parts. Wide 16:9 landscape. Labels as plain text, no brackets, spelled exactly as given; code-like labels in a monospace font. Do not add any heading above the columns and do not add any title to the green line other than the quoted label.
